verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago's own Subscriptions product documents recurring billing with weekly, monthly, or yearly frequency, trial periods, configurable proration, and automatic retries on rejected payments. Subscriptions can also be operated programmatically via the MP CLI. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of named plan objects and of plan upgrades/downgrades, depth beyond overview-level bullet points, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
